title: Sizing rule: maximum aggressiveness within survival
decision: Size by the maximum ruin-counted E[log W]; the survival limit (P(lose 80% in 60 days) <= 5%) is the only thing allowed to cut size
why: Principal ruling 2026-09-30 10:17Z; outranks the 0.02-lot floor where the two conflict

title: Single-name equities: cross-sectional books and the news lane
decision: Share CFDs mint hypotheses only in the cross-sectional class-book families, plus the news and earnings lane
why: Principal order 2026-09-30 11:29Z, amending the 2026-09-06 news-only order

title: Autonomy: no approval asks
decision: Lanes validate and merge their own PRs when CI failures are a subset of live's, pick the recommended default on forks, and raise only what is physically impossible without the principal

title: Subsystem admission rule
decision: A new subsystem ships only with a measured contract showing gain; for anything that moves capital the contract is out-of-sample E[log W]
why: Principal rule; stops organs that are built but never shown to add growth

title: Delegation protocol and repo research memory adopted
decision: context/ holds the delegation protocol, the decision journal and per-sleeve rationale; the box publishes the operator digest daily
why: Principal 2026-09-30: research must be a coordination system, not notebooks and chat that nobody revisits

title: Per-instrument regime kernel: built, not admitted on the bars bench
decision: libs/regime/control_room.py labels vol, trend/range and liquidity per instrument. On the bars bench (24 trend/range sleeves, 2021-07 to 2026-09, 65 monthly re-solves of the live solver) it lost 0.11 log/yr to the plain solve (CI90 spans 0). The allocator consumes it only if the box's run on the desk's real sleeves says GAIN
why: Admission rule; the bars bench cannot license sizing, the real-sleeve run can

title: Live gold-HMM world conditioning flagged
decision: On the same bench the allocator's live recipe (gold daily HMM conditioning every sleeve's worlds) lost 0.10 log/yr to the unconditioned solve (CI90 per day -0.00096 to +0.00017). Not removed: the box's real-sleeve contract run decides, and a removal would go through the desktop pass
why: Measured for the first time out of sample; the per-asset hierarchy the allocator's own docstring asked for is now built

title: Regime-first gating of the weekend-gap trade refused
decision: Keep the ungated gap fade. On 12 FX and metals, 2018-2026: fading the weekend gap earns +0.48R (n=3902); switching to follow it in trending regimes drops the gated book to +0.00R; fading only in ranges earns +0.53R vs +0.44R in trends (Welch t 1.64), a tilt at most, never a gate
why: Reverse-engineering of the seven-strategy operator's regime-first rule; a gate that forgoes a positive-expectancy regime costs growth (Rule 2)
